title: The Weather This Week
text:
Today the weather is good. The sun is bright and the sky is blue. It is warm in the afternoon. Tomorrow it will be cold and windy.

It rained last week. The rain was heavy, and the streets were wet. My friend likes snow, but I like the sun more. We hope the weather is nice on Sunday.

questions.text: What color is the sky today?
What was the weather like last week?
What can you infer about the weather tomorrow?
options: It will probably be colder than today.
It will be sunny and hot.
It will be the same as last week.

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the sun?
options: The writer is afraid of it.
The writer does not know it.

vocabulary.definition: the bright star that gives us light and heat during the day
the area above the earth where clouds and birds are
water that falls from clouds as drops
when there is a lot of moving air outside

paragraph_translations: Bugün hava güzel. Güneş parlak ve gökyüzü mavi. Öğleden sonra hava sıcak. Yarın hava soğuk ve rüzgarlı olacak.
Geçen hafta yağmur yağdı. Yağmur şiddetliydi ve sokaklar ıslaktı. Arkadaşım karı sever, ama ben güneşi daha çok severim. Pazar günü havanın güzel olmasını umuyoruz.
